verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents user-facing deletion only for stored memories (Settings > Personalization > Memory). Its self-hosted, offline and air-gapped deployment keeps data on the operator's own infrastructure, but that is deployment context, not a retention or deletion control. missing for 10: chat/conversation deletion, uploaded-file and RAG-document deletion, configurable retention periods or auto-expiry, account/data purge or export controls, admin-level retention policy, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Users can manually add, edit, or delete memories by navigating to: Settings > Personalization > Memory
self-hosted AI platform that's extensible, feature-rich, user-friendly, and built to run entirely offline
